title: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where humanity is prey to werewolves, vampires, the undead, geists, demons and other horrors, and where the Church of Avacyn is failing.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An archangel whose presence once held back the darkness of Innistrad and who has not been seen for several seasons.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The religion of Innistrad's humans, whose power to hold back dark forces is waning since Avacyn disappeared.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: An elder of the Church of Avacyn and its ruling Lunarch.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Specialized holy warriors trained by humans to strike back at the supernatural horrors.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A secret demon cult centered in Thraben with human members in the church, nobility and trades.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who rose to eclipse all other demons and disappeared around the same time as Avacyn.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: The province where humanity is safest and strongest, home to Thraben and plagued by undead and geists.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The largest city in the known world, in Gavony, housing the Cathedral of Avacyn.

entities.name: Cathedral of Avacyn
entities.description: The seat of religion in Thraben, where a great archangel once presided.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Innistrad's wooded hinterland province in perpetual autumn, prowled by werewolves.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: The dark, mountainous province controlled by vampires.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A coastal province of port towns populated by humans, geists and vampires.

entities.name: Blessed Sleep
entities.description: A tranquil eternity after death that Innistrad's people hope for as a reward for a virtuous life.

entities.name: Skaberen
entities.description: Alchemists who animate flesh and create abominations.

events.summary: Avacyn and her angels came to Innistrad and a new equilibrium was reached, driving back vampires, werewolves and the undead.
events.quote: But then Avacyn and her angels came, and with her presence a new equilibrium was reached.

events.summary: Demons and devils began to arrive in the opening left by the retreat of other monsters.
events.quote: The demons and their hosts of devils began to arrive, one by one.

events.summary: Avacyn fought and destroyed demons, who kept returning in new forms, so she decreed they be bound and adopted the silver collar as her symbol.
events.quote: Realizing this, Avacyn decreed that "What cannot be destroyed will be bound,"

events.summary: Griselbrand rose to eclipse all other demons, and the Skirsdag gained prominence.
events.quote: When the demon Griselbrand rose in power to eclipse all other demons, the Skirsdag gained prominence as well.

events.summary: Avacyn and Griselbrand disappeared around the same time.
events.quote: Griselbrand disappeared around the same time that Avacyn did

events.summary: With Avacyn missing, prayers and holy symbols fail to protect villages and the dead, and the Church's power wanes.
events.quote: But the archangel Avacyn has not been seen over the last few seasons, and her absence is beginning to tell.

relations.note: largest city in the known world
relations.quote: It is home to Thraben, largest city in the known world

relations.note: human cult furthering their lord's ends
relations.quote: leaving the humans of the Skirsdag to further his ends in their lord's absence.

relations.note: Avacyn set out to destroy and bind the demons
relations.quote: she knew she would have to destroy them.
